name: zutil_zar_request_stop_global
description: zUtil::ZAR_RequestStopGlobal null-checks the global ZBD manager and delegates to zZbdManager::RequestStop when present.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation and disassembly at 0x4c0070 show a null guard on g_zUtil_ZbdManager and a tail call to zZbdManager::RequestStop when non-null.
The direct callee zZbdManager::RequestStop is dependency-ready and functional-equivalent.
The native request-stop smoke verifies the null global path leaves the global null and the non-null global path sets stopRequested through the manager.
